purpose: Ingest authoritative sources surfaced by raw states 53239, 25933, 92335, 39425, 43529, 54923, 22345 and 32542, emphasizing maritime secured-network testing, Linux and AI-agent security, regulated cell-therapy manufacturing, PCB base materials, structural steel, logistics equipment and capture intelligence while keeping all identifier matches separate from Glob evidence.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, standard, method, software resource, operational precedent, commercial signal or information item receives a Worldshepherd use when it materially improves any capability, or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: NVD/vendor mirrors, alternate MHRA certificate views, standards-reseller copies and repeated opportunity listings for the same underlying item are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: CVE numbers, draft/specification identifiers, manufacturer authorisation numbers, product codes, article numbers and postal codes may be highly useful to Worldshepherd but have zero automatic Glob evidence unless the digits independently encode a verified physical quantity.

sources.title: CVE-2026-53239 — Linux XFRM policy use-after-free race
sources.note: Use as a concurrency/resource-lifetime hardening case involving lock release, RCU freeing and later use of an inexact policy bin. 53239 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: ISO/WD 25933 — Test methods and required results for secured ship network (SSN)
sources.note: Under development. Use as a draft reference for testable IPv6 ship-network security, TLS/DTLS 1.3, integrity/confidentiality, legacy IPv4 interoperability, smart-ship datagrams and secured/open-mode transition testing. 25933 is the draft identifier.

sources.title: QPL-25933 — Altimeter, Pressurized Compartment, Integrally Lighted, 0-50,000 Feet, 1-7/8 Inch Dial
sources.authority: DLA ASSIST QuickSearch / Air Force Sustainment Center
sources.note: Use qualified-products and governing-spec lineage as an aviation-instrument procurement/qualification reference. 25933 is a military specification/QPL identifier.

sources.title: CVE-2026-39891 — PraisonAI template injection in agent tool definitions
sources.note: Use as a direct agent-tool trust-boundary case: prior to 4.5.115, user-controlled input could reach template-rendering tools and evaluate template expressions rather than treating them as literals. 92335 is only a legacy vulnerability-database identifier.

sources.title: INTEL-SA-00969 — Intel Driver & Support Assistant vulnerabilities
sources.note: Use improper-access-control/privilege-escalation case and explicit patched-version boundary (23.4.33 or later) as a software asset/version-control precedent. 39425 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: IEC 61249-2-4:2001 — Reinforced base materials for printed boards
sources.note: Use copper-clad polyester/E-glass laminate property/flame-performance requirements as a PCB-material qualification reference. The raw target 43529 is only a reseller product code for a national adoption, not the IEC standard identifier.

sources.title: UK MIA 54923 and UK MIA(IMP) 54923 — Advent BioServices Ltd
sources.authority: UK Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency
sources.note: Current authorisations dated 22-Apr-2026. Use cell-therapy/live-cell aseptic manufacture, batch certification, packaging and QC scope as a regulated-manufacturing and partner due-diligence reference. 54923 is the authorisation identifier.

sources.title: Making large-size fail-safe steel by deformation-assisted tempering process
sources.note: Use 1.4-ton steel scale-up, microstructure engineering and fracture/impact/tensile validation as a structural-material process benchmark. 22345 is the article number.

sources.title: MIL-PRF-32542 — Truck, Forklift, 4,000 and 6,200 LB Capacity, Front/Side Loading, Non-Pneumatic, Internal Combustion Engine
sources.authority: DLA ASSIST QuickSearch / Air Force Life Cycle Management Center
sources.note: Active performance specification with next review due 14-Oct-2026. Use as a military material-handling equipment requirements/qualification reference. 32542 is the specification identifier.

sources.title: Eglin AFB 32542 technical opportunity cluster
sources.note: Retain relevant Eglin examples such as avionics-test-bench sustainment and distributed LVC integration/connectivity architecture as capture/domain precedents; each notice must be date/status screened independently. 32542 is the place-of-performance ZIP code, not the opportunity identifier.

information_updates.finding: ISO/WD 25933 gives Worldshepherd a test-oriented maritime cyber architecture rather than merely a security principle set: IPv6 behavior, application/service announcement, smart-ship datagrams, IPv4 interoperability, security-mode transitions and encrypted/authenticated transport are all explicit verification targets.
information_updates.claims_boundary: It is a working draft under development and must not be represented as a published final standard.

information_updates.finding: PraisonAI CVE-2026-39891 provides a concrete agentic-security pattern: values originating in prompts/agent instructions must remain data when handed to template/file/code-generation tools unless code evaluation is explicitly authorized, isolated and bounded.
information_updates.claims_boundary: This is a generalized hardening lesson; no claim is made that Worldshepherd currently depends on vulnerable PraisonAI.

information_updates.finding: MHRA 54923 expands the retrospective manufacturing due-diligence model into advanced biological products: authorization type/date, sterile/aseptic scope, live-cell product class, batch certification, packaging and microbiological/biological QC are explicit supplier-capability dimensions.
information_updates.claims_boundary: This is a transferable governance schema, not a claim that Worldshepherd is producing medicinal products.

information_updates.finding: The DAT steel paper is especially useful because it validates processing at 1.4-ton scale rather than only coupon scale, making it a strong reference for Worldshepherd's recurring requirement to connect material mechanisms to manufacturable large components.
information_updates.claims_boundary: The paper does not validate Worldshepherd alloy compositions; it provides a scale-up/validation precedent.

information_updates.finding: 32542 now has two clearly separate technical namespaces: MIL-PRF-32542 is an equipment specification, while Eglin AFB 32542 is a postal code recurring in federal opportunities. This is a strong namespace-disambiguation control and a useful capture-intelligence source at the same time.
information_updates.claims_boundary: The two 32542 uses are unrelated and must never be counted as independent physical evidence.

next_actions: Continue raw scanning and source-by-source retroactive utility backfill until all 208 union states have a defined namespace-aware observation or explicit revisable NO_HIT.
Cross-walk ISO/WD 25933 with the existing Navy sensor-fusion lineage and Worldshepherd maritime/autonomous architecture as a draft-reference test matrix, without claiming standards compliance.
Inspect Worldshepherd dependencies and agent/template/tool code paths for PraisonAI or analogous template-evaluation risks before generating a remediation requirement.
Continue same-system topology and relational verification independently for physical P1/P2 candidates with fixed tolerance and experiment-wide multiple-testing/false-discovery controls.
